name: Modal walking bass
desc: So-What-style modal walk in Eb dorian - a new key for the walking shelf: sixteen bars of static Eb dorian answered by a half-step lift to E dorian AABA-style, pedal-and-walk phrasing, quarter-note swing feel via elongation at peak fills.

root.doc: semitone offset from Eb dorian home

code.sparse: n("<[0@2 4@2] [0@2 6@2] [0@2 4@2] [2@2 0@2] [0@2 4@2] [0@2 6@2] [1@2 5@2] [1@2 0@2]>").scale("<eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian e2:dorian e2:dorian>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.012).decay(.3).sustain(.45).release(.2).shape(.2).lpf(${cut}*.8).clip(.92).gain(${gain}*.85).room(.25).orbit(3).play()
code.full: n("<[0 2 4 6] [0 3 4 6] [0 2 4 2] [0 6 4 2] [0 2 4 6] [7 6 4 2] [1 3 5 7] [1 5 4 2]>").scale("<eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian e2:dorian e2:dorian>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.008).decay(.25).sustain(.4).release(.15).shape(.28).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.75, ${cut}*1.2).slow(24)).clip(.9).gain(${gain}).room(.25).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply("1 1 1 2")).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: n("<[0 2 4 6] [0 3 4 6] [0 2 [4 5] 2] [0 6 4 2] [0 2 4 6] [7 6 [4 3] 2] [1 3 5 7] [1 5 [4 3] 2]>").scale("<eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian eb2:dorian e2:dorian e2:dorian>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.5).slow(8)).lpq(3).attack(.006).decay(.18).sustain(.3).release(.1).shape(.32).clip(.88).gain(${gain}).room(.22).every(4, x=>x.ply("1 1 1 2")).orbit(3).play()
